# ADR-3262: AWS root_mfa: Documented root login for account closure 6

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Some account lifecycle actions need root.

## Decision

Finance MAY adopt a documented root login for account closure 6 (AWS-root_mfa-6) when AWS requires root for closure flows.

## Consequences

Logins are witnessed and ticketed.
